children: LAKELAND INDUSTRIES INC reported a second-quarter 2027 net loss as revenue declined modestly versus the year‑ago quarter. For the three months ended July 31, 2026, revenue was $50.1M, a (4.5%) decrease from $52.5M a year earlier, and the company recorded a net loss of $(4.9)M, or diluted EPS of $(0.50), compared with net income of $0.8M and EPS of $0.08 in the prior-year quarter.
Revenue was $50.1M for Q2 FY27, compared with $52.5M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change (4.5%).
Net income was a loss of $(4.9)M for Q2 FY27, versus net income of $0.8M in the year‑ago quarter.
Diluted EPS was $(0.50) for Q2 FY27, versus $0.08 in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue trends: Net sales declined YTD (~1.7%) and QTD (~4.5%), driven in part by the divestiture of the High Performance/High Visibility product lines.
Channel and product shift: Management is focusing more on Fire Service, Chemical, Disposable and Woven products following the sale of two product lines.
Brand and M&A momentum: LAKELAND acquired Arizona PPE and California PPE to expand UL‑certified decontamination/repair and training services.
Operational footprint: The company operates 10 manufacturing sites across eight countries to bolster supply-chain and manufacturing control.
Cost and margin drivers: Gross margins and pricing have been materially affected by tariff refunds, new tariffs, labor, freight and certification costs, prompting pricing actions.
